transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning, thank you for contacting S-Net customer support today. My name is Sonia. How can I help you this morning?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Sonia, my name is Evangeline. I'm calling because I ordered an S-Net Ultra TV multi-room mini box for our upstairs bedroom ten days ago, and it still hasn't arrived.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so sorry that you have been left waiting ten days for your bedroom mini box, Evangeline, and I completely understand how frustrating it is when an order is delayed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. Every single day I log into my online portal and the order status just says Pending Warehouse Dispatch. It hasn't moved once since the eighth of October.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I really appreciate how disappointing that must be when you are waiting to set up your upstairs television, Evangeline. Let me get into your account right away and check that order.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, I have my order reference number here if you need it, it's ORD-774190.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for that reference number. Before I open the order screen, could you please confirm the first line of your home address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, of course. The first line is 14 Ravenswood Gardens, Bristol, and my four-digit security PIN is 6309.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That matches our records, thank you, Evangeline. So just to make sure I have everything straight, you placed order ORD-774190 ten days ago on the eighth of October for an additional Ultra TV multi-room mini box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And ever since you placed that order for your upstairs bedroom, the online portal has been stuck showing Pending Warehouse Dispatch with no courier tracking details generated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Spot on. When I ordered it online, the checkout page promised delivery within two to three working days, so ten days without even leaving the warehouse feels ridiculous.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand why you feel that way, Evangeline, and I sincerely apologize that the two-to-three-working-day estimate was missed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My husband is recovering from knee surgery upstairs, which is the whole reason we added the multi-room subscription this month so he could watch the football and films in bed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, I am so sorry to hear your husband is recovering from knee surgery, Evangeline. That makes the delay with the bedroom box even more inconvenient for you both.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It really does. Meanwhile, my monthly bill projection already shows the extra twelve pounds a month for the multi-room add-on starting from the day I clicked order.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly see why that would add to your frustration. Please bear with me for a moment while I open up the order management screen for ORD-774190.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Evangeline, I really appreciate your patience while I pulled up the order details on my system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No problem, Sonia. What does your system say is holding it up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have order ORD-774190 open right here, and on my screen the fulfilment status is also showing as Pending Warehouse Dispatch at our Midlands distribution hub.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, well why is it still sitting in Pending Warehouse Dispatch after ten days? Is there a block on the order or did it get stuck in your system?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once an equipment order moves into the Pending Warehouse Dispatch status, it sits in the external logistics feed managed by our courier and warehouse partner, DHL Supply Chain.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, so can you push it through or get the warehouse to dispatch a box out to us today on next-day delivery?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our third-party logistics partner DHL handles the warehouse dispatch queue, there's nothing I can do from this desk—you'd have to contact their customer depot directly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, what? How can I contact DHL when I don't even have a DHL tracking number or consignment reference? I bought the box from S-Net!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very sorry about the inconvenience, Evangeline, and I understand it is frustrating, but our retail support system is completely separate from the DHL warehouse floor system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Surely S-Net has an internal fulfilment team or an order exceptions desk that talks to your own warehouse? You can't expect customers to ring up a warehouse depot!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On our customer service desktops we only have view-only access to the dispatch status line once the order is passed across to the third-party logistics provider.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can't you cancel this stuck order ORD-774190 and just key in a fresh dispatch so a new Ultra TV mini box gets sent out to 14 Ravenswood Gardens?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because the order status is locked in Pending Warehouse Dispatch, the cancel and reissue buttons are greyed out on my console until the warehouse clears or rejects the pick ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, why would the pick ticket be locked for ten days? Could there be an issue on my S-Net account holding it back, or is the mini box out of stock?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My screen just displays the generic Pending Warehouse Dispatch banner, Evangeline, so any stock allocation or pick-queue delays are handled purely on the DHL depot side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Didn't you check if there's an agreement document or credit check or anything waiting on my account? Sometimes upgrades wait for a click-to-accept email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I wouldn't have visibility of why the warehouse hasn't scanned the parcel yet, because our department only sees the tracking number once DHL prints the shipping label.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sonia, that makes no sense at all. If DHL hasn't even printed a shipping label, what am I supposed to say to them if I call their depot?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can quote your S-Net order reference ORD-774190 and your postcode at 14 Ravenswood Gardens to the DHL parcel enquiries line so they can search their manifest.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have you ever tried calling DHL without a DHL waybill number? Their automated phone system won't even let you speak to a human without a ten-digit tracking code!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am really sorry that their automated phone line is difficult to navigate, Evangeline, I completely understand how annoying that is when you just want your bedroom TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Being sorry doesn't get the mini box delivered, Sonia! You work for S-Net, my contract is with S-Net, not DHL.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I do appreciate your frustration, Evangeline, and I wish my console had a button to force the warehouse release, but hardware dispatch is outsourced to our logistics partner.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about escalating this to a team leader or raising an internal IT ticket to unstick the order from Pending Warehouse Dispatch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our team leaders have the exact same order portal view that I have on my screen, so they would only see the Pending Warehouse Dispatch status as well.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what happens if it sits in Pending Warehouse Dispatch for another two weeks? Am I just supposed to pay twelve pounds a month for a box that never arrives?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the box eventually gets scanned and delivered by the courier, you can give our billing team a ring and we will gladly backdate a credit for the days you were waiting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, so you can't even pause the twelve-pound multi-room billing charge right now while the box isn't even dispatched?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our billing adjustments for delayed equipment can only be calculated after the delivery scan closes the open order, because that tells the system how many days were missed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So let me get this straight. My order ORD-774190 has been stuck for ten days since the eighth of October, my husband is stuck in bed upstairs with no TV, and you're doing nothing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am truly sorry that we cannot manually push the parcel out from this desk, Evangeline. I have added a note to your account history confirming that you called today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A note on my account history doesn't tell the warehouse to put my Ultra TV mini box in a van, does it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the account note is just for our contact log so that when the box arrives and you claim your billing credit, the agent can see you reported the delay on the eighteenth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there an email or a phone number for the S-Net logistics or supply chain team that manages the DHL contract?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We don't have a direct phone number or email for the internal supply chain team, which is why customers have to reach out to the local DHL customer depot for dispatch queries.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what is the number for this DHL depot that you claim will look up an S-Net order number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can reach the DHL parcel customer service desk on 0344 248 0888, and if you select the option for missing home deliveries, an advisor can check your postcode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can guarantee you that when I call 0344 248 0888, they are going to tell me to go back to the retailer because S-Net is their account holder.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so sorry that you are caught in the middle of this delay, Evangeline, and I completely understand why you are unhappy with how long it is taking.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you at least check if there are any other notes or flags on order ORD-774190? Like why would a simple mini box take ten days?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All I can see on the summary tab is the item description for the S-Net Ultra TV multi-room mini box, the eighth of October order date, and Pending Warehouse Dispatch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You haven't even looked into any sub-menus or order workflow logs to see why the order hasn't progressed to picking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those workflow stages happen inside the warehouse management software, Evangeline, so from the customer support side we just wait for the courier feed to update to Dispatched.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, well if I had known adding a multi-room box for the bedroom was going to turn into a ten-day wild goose chase, I would have just bought a streaming stick.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand why you feel that way, Evangeline, and I really apologize again that your husband hasn't had the Ultra TV box in the bedroom while recovering.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And if DHL tells me they have no record of order ORD-774190 at 14 Ravenswood Gardens, what am I supposed to do then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the depot confirms they haven't received the manifest after fourteen full days, you can call us back on the twenty-second of October and our system may allow a manual cancellation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fourteen days! So I have to wait another four days before your system even lets someone cancel a stuck order?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the automated order lock stays active for fourteen calendar days while an item is in Pending Warehouse Dispatch to prevent duplicate boxes being shipped out.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is honestly the most unhelpful system I have ever heard of. You're basically telling me my hands are tied until the twenty-second.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very sorry that I don't have a way to override that fourteen-day warehouse lock from my terminal today, Evangeline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. Make sure your note on my account clearly states that I called ten days in and was told to ring DHL myself, because I will be claiming every penny of that twelve pounds back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have saved that detailed note on your profile under reference ORD-774190 right now, Evangeline, so the billing team will see the full timeline as soon as the box updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what reference number did you put on the contact note for today's call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The interaction log reference for today's call is INT-409281, and it is attached directly to your multi-room order ORD-774190.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I've written down INT-409281 and the 0344 248 0888 number for the depot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else on your S-Net broadband or main living room TV package that I can check for you today, Evangeline?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, the main box downstairs works fine, it's just this bedroom mini box order that's a complete mess.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very sorry again that we couldn't get it dispatched from here today, Evangeline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, I'll try ringing the courier depot now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I do hope your husband's knee recovery goes smoothly, Evangeline. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a good rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye, Sonia.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye, Evangeline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Bye.
